$schema_note: Aether<->Zeptun compatibility test matrix. Statuses: proven-by-source | proven-by-existing-tests | proposed (needs runtime PoC) | blocked.
interfaces_distinguished: Aether UPSTREAM client (aether -> external proxy): irrelevant to zeptun
Aether LOCAL SOCKS5 server (zeptun connects here): THE integration surface
Aether internal tunnel transport (QUIC/WG/h2 sockets): must bypass the TUN (loop prevention)
Zeptun SOCKS5 client: connects to aether's local server

checks.expectation: zeptun offers [0x00] (or [0x00,0x02]); aether replies 0x00 no-auth regardless
checks.status: proven-by-source

checks.expectation: data flows both ways; half-closed conns linger at most AETHER_HALF_CLOSE_SECS=30
checks.aether_evidence: socks.rs handle_connect L825+, relay_direct, half_close_linger L1175
checks.status: proven-by-source; end-to-end PoC required

checks.expectation: associate with zero target -> relay addr; datagrams with RSV/FRAG=0 headers; replies with source addr; association ends on control-conn close
checks.aether_evidence: socks.rs L1516-1631 handle_udp_associate; parse_udp_request (frag!=0 dropped); build_udp_reply
checks.status: proven-by-source BOTH sides; end-to-end PoC REQUIRED (per protocol mode)
checks.poc: DNS + QUIC + game-style UDP through tunnel

checks.expectation: Aether replies REP 0x07 command-not-supported -> all UDP fails
checks.status: BLOCKED-INCOMPATIBLE by source; app must pin udp_mode=udp

checks.what: UDP through each aether protocol mode
checks.expectation: masque-h3 (QUIC datagrams), masque-h2 (over h2), wg, gool, mim all carry UDP via netstack
checks.status: proven-by-source (architecture); runtime PoC per mode REQUIRED
checks.poc: run T3 against each of the 5 protocol modes

checks.expectation: DNS (port 53) only, carried over TCP; other UDP dropped with log
checks.status: proven-by-source (documented limitation); hide these modes or document

checks.expectation: zeptun fake_ip -> domain-target SOCKS dials -> aether --dns resolvers inside tunnel; hijack -> upstream; no cleartext DNS outside
checks.zeptun_evidence: stack/dns.zig fake-IP table (A/AAAA only, LRU); upstream forwarding
checks.status: proven-by-source; leak PoC REQUIRED (capture on physical iface)
checks.poc: tcpdump/wireshark on non-tunnel interface during resolutions

checks.expectation: both families proxied when both stacks configured
checks.status: proven-by-source; PoC REQUIRED (and: omit v6 TUN address when upstream lacks v6 - wiki Android note)

checks.expectation: aether binds listener immediately but only answers the greeting once the tunnel serves; app must wait for readiness (connect+greeting+[05 00] reply) BEFORE zeptun start
checks.aether_evidence: socks.rs answers()/until_answered L278-313; Listeners::bind before tunnel
checks.zeptun_evidence: warm pool would block on unanswered greeting
checks.status: proven-by-source; PoC REQUIRED (measure zeptun warm-pool behavior against held listener)
checks.poc: start zeptun before aether; expect pool retries then success

checks.expectation: tunnel drop -> aether holds listener, reconnects after reconnect-secs; zeptun pool drops dead conns (recv 0) and refills (socks5_pool_retries)
checks.aether_evidence: lib.rs run loops; held listener between tunnels
checks.zeptun_evidence: handler.zig dropWarm/pool refill; monitor_network drops cached conns
checks.status: proven-by-source; PoC REQUIRED (kill network / block endpoint mid-transfer)
checks.poc: firewall-drop the WARP endpoint, verify recovery without app restart

checks.expectation: stop zeptun first (routes removed), then aether (listener closed); no orphaned processes; no stale routes (zeptun clears its rule range on exit, even after crash)
checks.zeptun_evidence: route/linux.zig teardown; wiki Routing 'removed when the process stops'
checks.status: proven-by-source; PoC REQUIRED (kill -9 both, verify no stale rules/adapters)
checks.poc: SIGKILL test on Linux; taskkill on Windows

checks.expectation: Linux: aether --mark 0xff + 'ip rule add fwmark 0xff lookup main priority 100' (must sort BEFORE zeptun rules 9000-9009; zeptun rule 9005 sends everything NOT marked 0x2022 to the tunnel table, so an unmarked aether loops). Android no-root: addDisallowedApplication(own package) (+ zeptun protect()). Windows/macOS: zeptun flow-callback ZEPTUN_FLOW_DIRECT for WARP ranges (and/or route excludes)
checks.aether_evidence: egress.rs (mark all egress incl. QUIC/WG); DOCS.en.md 'Firewall mark'
checks.zeptun_evidence: route/linux.zig L640-706 rules; protect callback; flow callback verdicts
checks.status: proven-by-source (Linux recipe documented); cross-platform PoC REQUIRED - TOP RISK
checks.poc: with tunnel up, verify aether's egress leaves the physical interface and curl through the stack works (no blackhole)

checks.expectation: default 127.0.0.1 keeps the unauthenticated proxy local; aether logs a warning on world-reachable binds
checks.status: proven-by-source; app pins loopback

checks.what: Aether route rules apply to TUN-originated IP connections
checks.expectation: SNI/Host sniffing (AETHER_ROUTE_SNIFF on) lets domain rules work when zeptun hands IPs
checks.aether_evidence: socks.rs decide_route/read_sniff_head L786-852; DOCS.en.md 'Name rules behind a tun'
checks.status: proven-by-source; PoC: route-block a domain, visit it, expect refusal

checks.expectation: aether AETHER_MAX_CLIENTS (512-8192) vs zeptun max_tcp/udp sessions (mobile 1200/512) - zeptun mobile caps bind first
checks.status: proven-by-source; capacity PoC on target hardware
checks.poc: 500 concurrent connections (zeptun integration suite does this on Linux)

checks.expectation: icmp=auto -> local: the engine answers echo requests itself (socks5 cannot carry ICMP)
checks.zeptun_evidence: Config.icmpForward() - auto means forward only with direct handler
checks.status: proven-by-source

checks.expectation: UDP_SEGMENT/UDP_GRO per-datagram headers inside one sendmsg work against aether's relay (buffers sized 65535)
checks.status: proven-by-zeptun-tests against zeptun's own server; against AETHER needs PoC

checks.expectation: zeptun mobile 24 MB + aether (quiche+boring+tokio) footprint must fit the packet-tunnel-provider limit
checks.status: UNKNOWN - measuring PoC is a gate for iOS
checks.poc: run both engines in an extension on device, watch jetsam

checks.expectation: one aether core per process; flags overwrite env; do not run two cores concurrently
checks.aether_evidence: cli.rs set()/append(); api.rs connect() sets AETHER_HTTP_PROXY
checks.status: proven-by-source (constraint)

checks.expectation: 'connected' requires: aether tunnel serving (socks greeting answered) AND zeptun up (routes/fd active) AND a real end-to-end probe through the stack (curl via SOCKS or zeptun_stats counters advancing)
checks.status: design rule; enforce in app state machine

verdict: COMPATIBLE with two hard pins: (1) zeptun udp_mode MUST be 'udp' (standard UDP ASSOCIATE) - Aether implements it fully; (2) startup order + loop-prevention per platform must be engineered (T9, T12). tor-only/psiphon-only aether modes carry DNS-only UDP - treat as TCP-only transports for full-device routing.
